title: Jujutsu Kaisen Shares New Look At Stage Play As Fans Await Season 4
content: Although the Jujutsu Kaisen manga ended almost two years ago, the franchise continues to remain relevant thanks to its anime adaptation, sequel, and several other exciting projects.
author: ComicBook

title: 15 Years Ago, An Underrated Cartoon Network Revival Premiered (And It Deserves A New Look)
content: Cartoon Network has been bringing back some heavy hitters in recent days, with some of its classic franchises receiving new leases on life on streaming services worldwide. Regular Show has returned with Regular Show: The Lost Tapes , Adventure Time has returned with Adventure Time: Side Quests , and The Amazing World…

title: Naruto Card Game's Trailers Reveal Cards, Rules
content: Bandai Card Games began streaming two videos for Naruto Card Game , a new trading card game based on the Naruto series. The videos introduce cards and rules: The game will debut with tutorial sessions at this year's Gen Con event from Thursday-Sunday in Indianapolis.
author: ANN

title: New Venom Movie Confirmed But It Might Not Be What Marvel Fans Want Right Now
content: A new Venom movie has been confirmed to be in the works, but it might not be the one that Marvel fans want to see right now. Sony’s cinematic universe of Spider-Man characters has been in the midst of a flux for the past few years.
author: ComicBook

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Producer Explains Long Wait for New Steel Ball Run Episodes
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is coming back to Netflix later this Fall with its second wave of episodes, and the producer behind the series explained why there’s been such a long wait before these new episodes.
author: ComicBook

title: New Ghost in the Shell Anime Announces 2 New Cast Members
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced two new cast members and characters for The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime from Science SARU on Thursday. The characters appeared in the anime's fourth episode on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: A Disney Animated Revival Has Released Its Final Season
content: Disney has brought back some of its biggest animated franchises in recent years to major success. One of the biggest examples of this has been Phineas and Ferb’s return, with the franchise set to release a sixth season on Disney+ in the future.
author: ComicBook

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game's Expansion Pass Trailer Reveals August 5 Launch for Bubbly Basin DLC
content: Nintendo and The Pokémon Company began streaming on Wednesday an extended trailer for the paid Expansion Pass DLC and free update for Pokémon Pokopia , their cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise , and it announces that the DLC and update will launch on August 5.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Dark Action Anime Hit Finally Reveals First Look at Season 2 Return
content: One of Crunchyroll’ s darkest action anime hits is coming back for a second season, and fans have gotten the first look at what to expect from the new episodes. 2025 was a fantastic year for anime with not only standout new debuts, but returns of some big franchises that fans had been waiting for.
author: ComicBook

title: Inherit the Winds TV Anime Casts Ayumu Murase
content: The official X/Twitter account for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) revealed on Wednesday that Ayumu Murase will play Tōdō Heisuke ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ), the assistant vice commander of the Mibu Roshigumi.
author: ANN
